Raised in the bleak corridors of a Victorian workhouse, a resilient young outcast escapes into the treacherous underbelly of London, where he is forced into a ruthless syndicate of pickpockets and thieves. Amidst the fog-choked slums and opulent parlors of the city, he must navigate a brutal world of crime and exploitation just to stay alive. As he rises through the criminal ranks, his struggle for survival transforms into a fierce indictment of a society that preys upon its most vulnerable children.
